title: Quick Flaky German Dough Dumplings
description: A traditional German dish featuring turmeric powder, these dumplings are a crowd-pleaser and can be made gluten-free friendly. They are best served steamed in a bamboo steamer.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: gluten-free flour can be used as substitute

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, turmeric powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the melted butter to the egg mixture and whisk until combined.
Slowly pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and fold in half to form a half-moon shape.
Place the dumplings in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 15 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite sauce or topping.
